difficulty_reason: Second-largest proof of the chapter: endows Aut(xi) with a quasi-coherent module structure via the I' = U' x_{x',X',x'} U' machine - the diagonal Delta' is a section of the action sheaf, the derivations-action lemma gives Aut(xi) = SheafHom(Delta*Omega_{I/U}, C_{U/U'}), then the three checks run in-span: etale-localization compatibility of the isomorphism (footnote topological-invariance argument), quasi-coherence from Omega_{I/U} finite locally free plus the conormal sheaf, and composition = addition through the groupoid structure c' on I'.
